newsitem.title: GERMANY: DHL logistics cost CD-ROM for German shippers.
newsitem.headline: DHL logistics cost CD-ROM for German shippers.

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express said it will issue cargo shippers in Germany with a cost calculation CD-ROM allowing transport and logistics cost savings of up to 50 percent.

Marina Walser, marketing project manager, said firms could compare existing logistics costs to the potential costs of closing company-owned foreign warehouses and transporting goods direct by express service instead.
Slightly higher taansport costs would be far outweighed by lower warehousing and distribution costs and the improved delivery service, she added at the Transport '97 trade fair in Munich.
"Contact lens firm Ciba Vision already uses the CD-ROM, and now sends every order from a central German store by DHL. This has cut storage by 50 percent while improving delivery," she noted.
DHL had used inter-continental air cargo rates or European freight forwarding prices to calculate transportation costs, Walser added.

DHL will mail the CD-ROM to 5,000 German clients in July arid offer customers individual advice on how to assess their own individual costs, she said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
